obfuscation_indicators: forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The excerpt presents a generally constructive operating outlook, supported by quantified revenue and expense changes, but includes substantial boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and optimistic projections regarding technology and operational improvements. Key risks include labor availability and wage pressure, restructuring and integration costs, execution risk from major systems deployments, and uncertainty in self-insurance reserves. The truncated and partially repetitive expense discussion limits full assessment of underlying performance drivers.
